line: A jaded genius opens a portal just to buy coffee and tumbles through ever-stranger universes.
line_cn: 厌世天才开传送门只想买杯咖啡，却穿过越来越离谱的平行宇宙。

camera.serves: the cut-off line; the realisation; a lie

camera.move: Insert extreme close-up of an object
camera.serves: a reveal; the problem itself; the wrong result

camera.expresses: the laugh lives on the face

camera.move: Tight close-up + short shake on one word
camera.serves: the key word; an alarm; a scream

camera.move: Rush zoom into the portal → swirl wipe
camera.serves: any jump between places, times or versions
a montage; a comparison; a list

camera.serves: the pause after a reversal; a confession

camera.serves: a callback; a trap; a fresh start
a fight; a bet; a double take

transitions: Transitions go through the travel device (swirl wipes) or hard cuts;
labels: Subtitles: bottom centre, a rounded heavy sans (Baloo 2 ExtraBold ~50 px), white with a ~11 px black outline, so they look like the cartoon's own captions, with a small speaker pill in the character's colour (boiling outline) on the left. Lines over ~1300 px wrap to two lines. Overlapping lines stack; the older one dims to ~70 %.

Timing: hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s) for narration; for rapid dialogue, max(audio + 0.35 s, 0.9 s + chars / 17). Clip at world changes and before a silent beat, so the silence plays on a clean screen.

Title: chunky display lettering popped in on 12 fps steps on a musical hit. Choose a period look that is not the source genre's logo: avoid acid green, slime drips and wobbly bubble lettering together, which reads as a specific show.
Keep faces out of the subtitle band (bottom ~170 px) and the world tag clear of faces.
motion: Characters on twos (12 fps): poses, mouths, blinks, walk cycles and boil step at 12 fps. Camera moves, portal swirl, flying props and wipes on ones (24 fps).
Acting over moving: held poses with small changes (eye twitch, pupils sliding, a gulp, sweat drops). Idle life: breathing (±1 % squash), a nod driven by speech loudness.
Squash & stretch on landings (decaying cosine squash ~22 %), stretch while flying out of a portal; "sucked in" = scale toward the portal centre while stretching.

native_moves.name: Parallel worlds
native_moves.does: Each jump = new palette, new cue, new creature.
native_moves.fits: versions of a product; careers you could have had; the same city in five eras.

native_moves.name: Duo contrast
native_moves.does: Deadpan vs panic: the joke is in the difference between reactions.
native_moves.fits: a veteran and a new hire; a parent and a teenager; an AI and its user.

native_moves.name: Rule of three → machine-gun
native_moves.does: Two slow wrong answers, then one-second worlds cut on the beat with the same rejection word.
native_moves.fits: failed prototypes; bad date ideas; tax forms.

native_moves.name: The suspiciously normal world
native_moves.does: The pattern breaks; the calm is the joke.
native_moves.fits: the one boring answer that works; a quiet office after chaos; the real customer.

native_moves.name: Dead-air reversal
native_moves.does: A long silence after the twist, then one line revealing a character's values.
native_moves.fits: a price reveal; a fine print clause; a gift that wasn't wanted.

native_moves.name: Hardware as junk
native_moves.does: World-bending tech used for a petty chore.
native_moves.fits: a quantum computer used for a grocery list; a rocket to deliver a sandwich; a time machine to fix a typo.

native_moves.name: Callback button
native_moves.does: The last line repeats the first so the story loops.
native_moves.fits: a catchphrase of a brand; a morning routine; a running complaint.

score.note: theremin lead over analog bass, square arpeggio, retro drum machine
